author: Insta360
description:
One camera. No cinema rig. Just Insta360 Luna Ultra and a supercar that gives you angles from every direction.

Shout out to @couchoud , this cinematic car showcase follows a Lamborghini from deep forest roads to an old stone-arch bridge, shot in 8K on Insta360 Luna Ultra: a 1-inch, Leica co-engineered gimbal camera built for tracking shots, wheel-level passes, and wind-whipped runs, all from one handheld setup.

See what Luna Ultra can do on a mountain run, from sweeping tracking shots and wheel close-ups to low-angle aero shots and the motion blur only a mechanical gimbal delivers. One creator, one handheld camera, and a road built for it.

Featured in this video:
- Sweeping mountain-pass shots at 4K120fps
- DeepTrack AI tracking on the bridge, 8K30fps
- Drift and burnout close-ups with wheel-level motion blur
- Low-angle aero and interior detail shots, framed on the detachable 2-inch OLED screen

Get your Insta360 Luna Ultra here → https://bit.ly/GetyourLunaUltra
